author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Stanford University researchers have developed a groundbreaking chip that effectively segregates mixed light into its individual components. This novel technology facilitates the analysis of coherence modes of light that were once challenging to identify. Utilizing advanced photonic techniques, the chip can enhance applications in fields like imaging and astronomy, potentially transforming our understanding of microscopic particles and faraway celestial phenomena.
title: Stanford scientists build fingernail-sized chip to separate mixed light

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: In a fascinating discovery, researchers have found that mother pufferfish provide their larvae with a nearly non-toxic chemical that effectively helps them escape predators. This chemical deters potential threats by making them unpalatable, thus improving the young fish's chances of survival. Additionally, this same chemical intriguingly attracts other pufferfish, revealing a unique dual role that aids in their survival strategies during vulnerable stages.
title: Baby pufferfish inherit chemical defence from mothers to deter predators

description: Once a forgotten gem, a historic mansion in Brooklyn Heights from 1852 has been meticulously transformed and is now available for $14.99 million. The adjacent carriage house can be purchased separately for $6 million. After a decade-long renovation focused on preserving its original beauty while integrating luxury amenities, this estate invites potential buyers to explore various living arrangements, from family homes to vibrant workspaces.

description: A historic fire station in Manhattan has been transformed into a luxury townhouse and sold for $19 million. It originally served the community as a firehouse for over a century before being decommissioned. The property underwent extensive renovations, highlighting its unique features such as an underground jazz club. Notably, the townhouse retains elements of its industrial past while incorporating modern living spaces.

This innovative tool classifies residential locations under red flag warnings into four specific risk categories, empowering local residents. description: A federal appeals court confirmed the dismissal of civil rights claims by AB Realty against Omaha officials. The lawsuit arose after the city shut down a building due to code violations in 2018. Despite the claims alleging Fourth, Fifth, and Fourteenth Amendment violations, the court found insufficient evidence to support them. The ruling highlighted that the city had acted according to legal standards during the inspections.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Robert Wilson crafted an impressive sculpture of a jackrabbit from salvaged components of a 1953 Chevrolet Bel Air. Titled Run, this artwork symbolizes the rich heritage of Route 66 through its creative design. Towering at over 10 feet, it is richly detailed to reflect its automotive origins. Situated in Babe Ruth Park, Gallup, this piece celebrates the 100th anniversary of the legendary highway, inviting visitors to appreciate its artistry.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A groundbreaking archaeological find at Tunnug 1 in southern Siberia unveiled cannabis seeds within a prince's tomb, dating back 2,800 years. This tomb is tied to intricate funerary rites, including horse sacrifices. Notably, preserved human hair revealed traces of cannabis, hinting at its psychoactive use, which underscores cannabis's significant role in ancient burial customs. Researchers plan to conduct further DNA analysis to deepen the understanding of its historical relevance.
title: 2,800-year-old Siberian tomb reveals cannabis seeds and traces in human hair

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: After her relationship concluded, Mary Roth pursued the return of over $110,000 she invested in home enhancements. However, the North Dakota Supreme Court determined that she could not secure restitution through an unjust enrichment claim. The ruling underscored that Roth needed to demonstrate an actual financial benefit to the property owner, something her receipts failed to do when it came to increasing the property's market value.

author: TOI WORLD DESK

The royal estate held decades of cherished family memories, offering her peace and comfort amid nature. From royal summer holidays to her final moments, discover why Balmoral remained one of the Queen’s most treasured places throughout her life.

The 2004-born player recovered from an opening defeat to finish with seven points. His achievement marks a major milestone for Indian chess, 38 years after Viswanathan Anand became the country's first Grandmaster.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals has overturned a previous decision regarding a premarital home. The court ruled that the husband is not liable for the home's market value increase during marriage. This ruling clarifies how separate property and marital contributions are treated in divorce cases. However, the former wife is entitled to financial interest from mortgage principal payments made during the marriage.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: An Ohio homeowner was ordered to pay a contractor $45,806 for a concrete foundation with cosmetic flaws. The court found that structural integrity was maintained, despite visible surface defects. The homeowner had initially refused payment, claiming that the imperfections reduced property value. The appeals court upheld the lower court decision, emphasizing the importance of structural safety over cosmetic issues.
title: Ohio homeowner refuses to pay for basement flaws; court upholds $45,806 bill

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: On Sunday, a visitor was injured when part of the false ceiling at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport collapsed, according to airport officials. The unfortunate event occurred outside Terminal 2. First aid was administered swiftly by the airport's emergency medical team. Authorities are currently investigating the cause of the collapse and are also checking the structural safety of the adjacent ceiling area.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The Ohio Court of Appeals has upheld that a husband retains ownership of his pre-marriage house, resisting claims from his ex-wife. The judges clarified that the use of rental income for payments did not affect the house's classification as separate property. Moreover, the court ordered his ex-spouse to cover $20,000 in legal fees, highlighting the tensions caused by her legal maneuvers throughout their prolonged dispute.
title: Ohio man keeps house bought before marriage; court upholds $20,000 legal fee award

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Mona Matherne spent over a decade contesting neighbors' use of a private road beside her country home. In November 2026, state appeals judges upheld her property rights and confirmed previous court orders. Matherne successfully argued against her neighbors, who claimed the road was public. The court ruled that only the first 1,000 feet was public, protecting Matherne's privacy.

description: In Siddharthnagar, nearly 100 residents became ill after consuming contaminated pani puri and tikki from a street vendor. Affected individuals reported symptoms such as vomiting and diarrhoea shortly after eating the food. description: Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production at Gigafactory Texas around mid-2027, Elon Musk said on X, to make room for more Cybercab robotaxis. Musk once called the stainless-steel pickup Tesla's best product ever, but sales never came close to his 250,000-a-year target. US sales fell 48% to 20,237 in 2025, while repeated recalls, years of delays and steep pricing hurt demand for the polarising truck.

The incident resulted in the deaths of Vinodni Shukla, Anshika Shukla, and her infant son Aarav. Harsh Shukla, Anshika's husband, survived with minor injuries after being trapped under the debris. The 35-year-old ancestral house had structural issues due to water seepage. Authorities are investigating the incident and have ordered postmortems for the deceased.

description: The growing use of artificial intelligence in classrooms is changing how students learn, complete assignments and approach academic challenges. While AI offers quicker access to information, personalised explanations and creative opportunities, educators warn that excessive dependence could weaken independent thinking. Drawing on survey findings and expert perspectives, the story examines how schools can integrate AI without compromising critical thinking, subject knowledge and learning skills.

description: Manoj Arora expressed pride in his daughter's achievements in Helsinki amid Delhi's worsening air quality. He shared pollution level comparisons between Delhi and Helsinki to highlight environmental concerns. The conversation attracted attention from parents considering similar moves for their children. Arora emphasized his daughter's hard work and scholarship that enabled her move abroad. The Supreme Court also discussed Delhi pollution, indicating a growing concern about air quality in India.
